description: Reviewed Gymnasium G8/G9 duration-model decisions for SkillPilot source-extraction scopes. The policy is about source/projection semantics; canonical goals remain shared.

decisions.subject: Mathematik
decisions.rationale: The Hessen Sek-I mathematics source extraction carries reviewed G8/G9 evidence with different grade placements; learner-facing G8/G9 composition views are generated from that evidence.

decisions.subject: Mathematik
decisions.rationale: The local Brandenburg mathematics source is the Berlin-Brandenburg Rahmenlehrplan Jahrgangsstufen 1-10 with Niveau-based standards; it does not encode separate G8/G9 learner-facing grade projections.

decisions.subject: Mathematik
decisions.rationale: The local Berlin mathematics source is the Berlin-Brandenburg Rahmenlehrplan Jahrgangsstufen 1-10 with Niveau-based standards; it does not encode separate G8/G9 learner-facing grade projections.

decisions.subject: Mathematik
decisions.rationale: The local Bayern LehrplanPLUS mathematics source extraction covers Gymnasium Jahrgangsstufen 5-13; no separate G8 learner-facing projection is modeled for this source.

decisions.subject: Mathematik
decisions.rationale: Baden-Wuerttemberg now has G8 and G9 Gymnasium structures, but the local BP2016 mathematics extraction encodes shared Kompetenzbaender 5/6, 7/8 and 9/10 rather than separate G8/G9 source placements. SkillPilot therefore keeps one learner-facing projection for this source until source evidence justifies separate views.

decisions.subject: Mathematik
decisions.rationale: Bremen Gymnasien lead to the Abitur after 12 school years; the local mathematics source is treated as one G8 projection.

decisions.subject: Mathematik
decisions.rationale: Hamburg Gymnasium uses the eight-year path to the Abitur; the local mathematics source is treated as one G8 projection.

decisions.subject: Mathematik

decisions.subject: Mathematik

decisions.subject: Mathematik
decisions.rationale: Rheinland-Pfalz has both nine-year Gymnasium and G8GTS Gymnasium paths. The local mathematics source extraction uses reviewed rpStage bands for Orientierungsstufe, Klassenstufen 7/8 and Klassenstufen 9/10; SkillPilot exposes explicit G8/G9 learner-facing projections from those bands without duplicating canonical goals.

decisions.subject: Mathematik
decisions.rationale: Schleswig-Holstein is predominantly G9 but still has G8 and Y-model Gymnasien. The retained SH mathematics source-json snapshot preserves the official source-native year bands 5/6, 7/8/9 and 10; SkillPilot exposes explicit G8/G9 learner-facing projections by shifting the source bands 7-10 to 6-9 for G8, while keeping canonical goals shared.
